llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Nansen CLI workflow for checking a wallet portfolio, with authentication and possible paid API use clearly called out.

dimensions.detail: Use of NANSEN_API_KEY or a saved browser session is proportionate for Nansen account access, and the skill discloses that API calls may consume credits or trigger authorized x402 payments.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It declares installation of the nansen-cli Node package and requires the nansen binary; this is coherent for the skill, though users should understand they are installing and trusting that external CLI package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill limits tool use to the nansen CLI and instructs the agent to verify authentication, stop on invalid or uncertain auth states, and avoid falling back to anonymous access.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No bundled scripts, background workers, persistence hooks, privilege escalation, or local system modification beyond installing and using the declared CLI are present in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The commands and instructions align with the stated purpose: using Nansen to fetch historical balances, current balances, and PnL for a provided wallet address and chain.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use Nansen for wallet portfolio analysis and are comfortable with the nansen-cli package, account/session access, and any API credit or x402 payment behavior governed by your existing Nansen wallet authorization and limits.
